OBJECTIVE OF THE PROGRAM
The officer will coordinate the regional network of public health laboratories for the
diagnosis of epidemic-prone diseases and support epidemiological surveillance.
DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES
- Coordinate the regional laboratory network for the diagnosis of emerging diseases.
- Support the integration of laboratory results into surveillance information systems.
- Provide technical cooperation to national reference laboratories.
Deliverables
Deliverable date
Product
Value
Total
Product 1: Laboratory network assessment report
Product 2: Training plan for national reference laboratories
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- University degree in a health science.
- Experience coordinating laboratory networks.
Only candidates holding a degree from an institution listed in the World Higher Education
Database (WHED) of the International Association of Universities (IAU) and UNESCO will be
considered; see www.whed.net/home.php and nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator/default.asp. Staff
rules follow the organization e-Manual. Follow us on LinkedIn. ReqID R-104233.
